entry_points.text: IRQ-line ioctl decodes type/vCPU/number, handles CPU bare and PPI/SPI via lazy init under mutex, validates GICv5/private ranges and translates; encoding packs fields; CPU line atomically updates, requests/kicks on change.

VCPU ioctl multiplexes init/reg/list/attr/event/finalize, gating reg/event on init with reset ordering and list on finalize with two-stage sizing; attr outer forwards to arch PMU/timer/steal; events clear/fill and reject nonzero reserved, report SError only when pending+available with masked bits, never pending abort.

exports.text: Derives v2/v3 VCPU interface control from pending/active/SGI summary, enabling interface and signaling overflow, EOI-count and deactivation traps; overflow compares pending and pending+active to LR count; summary holds counts, interfaces hold control words and LR file.

Tears down stage-2 across slots and nested tables via helper, intersecting host mappings and skipping holes under nested locks; reports CPU target generic/impl, IPA limit, PMU max and default-PMU result.
Inits nested under config mutex, validating EL2 variant, zeroing control page, growing S2 array in chunks and releasing on failure; sizes range from fixed IPA limit.

PMU/pvtime/arch attrs plus PMU ceiling; PMU IRQ/filter/backing/count/init, pvtime one-shot address, groups PMU/timer/steal; filter validates range/action/state and applies bitmap; ceiling from debug register with caps; faults and missing controller rejected.

Single-reg read/write validates arch class then routes core/fw/SVE/sys; counts/copies fw/sys lists plus combined builder with size query and advancing; fw/sys single getters take VCPU and descriptor; user-store faults abort without advancing.

hazards.text: Depends on external bit/atomic/mutex/memory/cpumask/kvm helpers listed; behavior not specified here.

invariants.text: Features start valid minus unsupported; rejects unknown/nonzero/split/strict/illegal combos; change diffs VM vs incoming; setup adds default PMU then nested; bits include 32-bit/PMU/SVE/PA/nested/off.
Probes PMUs for current CPU under global mutex; count needs existing monitor and value within host max; updates rewrite PMU partition in all VCPU views when nested.
TTL maps level+granule to sizes 1G/2M/4K/32M/16K/512M/64K, zero for L0 and most L1, wrapper falls back to 1G; exponents 12/14/16 select granules, negative bypasses; bad exponent traps.
Core count walks general+FP words, skipping vectors when SVE on; SVE zero without feature else slices*(pred+data)+term+length with slices=1; pre-finalize SVE warns.
Skips descriptors lacking backing/handlers or hidden; IDs carry markers plus 5 selectors, accept 64-bit only, reject reserved and resolve by ordered search; timer aliases normalize to canonical.
Demux cache is fixed 32-bit tail needing clean in-range IDs; reads prefer override else min line size single set/way; fw has version, 3 WA levels, 4 bitmap words.
SVE lists VLS then V/P/FFR per slice, needs finalized support, truncates/pads; VLS bits by word/mask; core checks offset/width and routes ranges.

locks.text: List lock spans sort/summary; IRQ lock spans populate and per-entry during summary; sort snapshots VM control and orders; summary zeroes, skips other-VCPU entries and tallies pending/active/SGI.
Config mutex spans PMU install and backing selection; install records PMU; selection searches by type, rejects after run or filter mismatch, copies mask and snapshots slots when strict.

VNCR invalidations need MMU write lock, gated on nested feature, whole-space 0..2^size with null tolerated; walk discards valid overlapping entries using exponent/level region, start-inclusive end-exclusive.

state_machines.text: Target first-time copies/setups/resets/marks under mutex unless finalized; re-init only resets unchanged; ioctl one-shots power-off, refreshes memory/cache, resets IRQ and publishes state under spinlock.
Monitor goes configurable until created then busy; IRQ passes consistency with default on newest gen; commit injects abort then SError, clears emulation and adjusts PC.

structs.text: Fill stores image and updates sw: clears edge, consumes SGI source restoring if left, lowers mapped level, sets resident; one folds priority, other gates SGI on emulated model; clear empties slot; fill ordering needs IRQ lock.
VNCR entry holds valid flag, write PA, exponent/level and unmap handle; per-VM valid count decrements on discard; discarding invalid asserts fatal.

Descriptor holds index, handlers, visibility hook and 5 selectors; param record holds selectors; slice map holds offset/valid/pad; core IDs prefix+offset+size 8/16/4B ordered by offset, skipping unaligned; bad size warns.
